title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates.
content:
## Introduction
A well-balanced diet is crucial for a healthy pregnancy. International pantry staples can provide a variety of essential nutrients for pregnant women. In this article, we will explore the best international pantry staples for pregnancy nutrition and provide practical tips on how to incorporate them into your diet.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
Some of the best international pantry staples for pregnancy nutrition include:
- Oats: rich in fiber, which can help support digestive health and reduce the risk of constipation.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, protein, and probiotics, which can help support bone health and immune function.
- Lentils: rich in protein, fiber, and iron, which can help support fetal development and reduce the risk of anemia.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, which can help support fetal brain and eye development.
- Eggs: rich in protein, vitamins, and minerals, which can help support fetal development.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins, minerals, and fiber, which can help support immune function and reduce the risk of vitamin deficiencies.

## Combining International Pantry Staples
To create a balanced diet, pregnant women can combine these international pantry staples in various ways. For example:
- Breakfast: oatmeal with Greek yogurt and fruit.
- Lunch: salad with lentils, eggs, and low-mercury salmon.
- Dinner: soup with leafy greens and lentils.

## Food Safety Considerations
When pregnant, it is essential to consider food safety to reduce the risk of foodborne illness. Some key considerations include:
- Cooking food thoroughly before eating.
- Avoiding raw or undercooked food.
- Washing hands before preparing and eating food.
- Storing food at a safe temperature.

## Conclusion
A well-balanced diet that includes international pantry staples can provide essential nutrients for a healthy pregnancy. By incorporating these staples into your diet and following food safety guidelines, you can reduce the risk of nutrient deficiencies and foodborne illness.
